summary: Dependency resolved from unpinned GitHub repository default branch
details: package.json for @chatbridgeworld/baileys@1.0.2 declares the `libsignal` dependency as `github:chatbridgegit/libsignal-node` — a bare GitHub tree reference with no commit SHA and no version pin. On `npm install`, npm fetches whatever the default branch of that repository currently points at and executes any lifecycle scripts contained in those bytes, with no integrity check and no reproducibility guarantee across installs. Whoever controls the chatbridgegit/libsignal-node repository can push arbitrary code into every subsequent install of this package. The dependency name (`libsignal`) also matches the host package's own ecosystem naming (Baileys forks typically depend on the npm-published libsignal-node), consistent with a dependency-source redirection shape.
